title: Ovariectomy \(Oophorectomy)
protocol: Fast the rat for 16 hours.
Take out sterilized surgical instruments from the autoclave and set up the surgery table.
Turn on the surgical lights.
Turn on the hood.
Pour halothane into the vaporizer and glass desiccator.
Switch on the pressure regulator on the oxygen tank.
Set halothane vaporizer to 2% halothane in 2.0 L oxygen/min at 1 ATM, 760 mmHg.
Use thick gloves to take the rat out of its cage and put it into a container with a lid.
Put the rat into a glass desiccator with vaporized halothane inside under the hood.
Watch carefully not to over-anesthetize the rat.
After the breathing rate of the rat slows down, take out the rat from the desiccator.
Lay the rat on its ventral surface with its tail towards the investigator on the operating board.
Insert the mouth and nose of the rat into a syringe tube attached to the halothane vaporizer.
Dip a folded gauze sponge in D.I. water and place it on the mouth of the rat.
Shave both sides of flanks near the hump of the rat.
Wrap the hair with a paper towel and discard it.
Clean the abdomen and flank with two wet Kimwipers followed by one dry Kimwipe.
Sterilize both sides of the flanks with Betadine-dipped gauze sponge.
Wash away the Betadine with D.I. water-dipped and dry Kimwipers.
Prepare a pair of sterile surgical gloves for the surgeon.
Cut the left flank skin layer along the abdominal line using Adson forceps in the surgeon’s left hand and 12 cm straight blunt scissors in the right hand.
Nick cut the muscle layer with 12 cm straight sharp scissors to form a small hole.
Use Graefe forceps to locate the ovaries surrounded by fat.
Pull out the ovary through the muscle incision by grasping the periovarian fat, ensuring not to touch the ovary itself.
Cut the junction between the Fallopian tube and the uterine horn using 12 cm blunt scissors along with accompanying blood vessels and fat.
Return the uterine horn into the abdominal cavity.
Close the incision using an Autoclip wound closing system.
Repeat steps from cutting the left flank to closing the incision on the right side.
Place the rat back into the cage.
Check the health status of the rat several hours later.
Monitor the health status of the rat for the following several days.
